name: zhouxing-no-input-blue-fallback

style_reference.origin: AI-generated cobalt-blue editorial office reference for task-driven collaboration
use_for: task interaction and furniture support guidance
do_not_copy: the whole composition or fixed object placements
an office setting for every supplied character
reference colors over the project palette

scope: Built-in blue is a no-input candidate only. Explicit instructions and supplied visual color relationships guide project colors; coordinate them with preserved character colors. Learn color roles, area hierarchy, saturation, temperature and page rhythm. Authentic screenshots retain original colors.
selection_priority: supplied visual-reference color relationships coordinated with character identity
major character color families when no color reference is supplied
built-in blue fallback when no input establishes a palette

palette_policy.source: Lock the project primary from explicit instructions or the designated reference first. Preserve existing reference secondary colors rather than forcing one hue.
palette_policy.native_colors: Record roles.primary and audit actual native background/text/fill/stroke colors against the declared palette; retain primary recognition across pages.
palette_policy.avoid: copying identity-board annotations, skin or every minor detail color; forcing all new props to one hue
palette_policy.background_selection: Use neutral white/gray/near-black or a justified reference background to separate the character. Changing the backdrop does not change the primary color. Do not add warm complementary hues merely to distinguish blue clothing.
palette_policy.secondary_colors: No additional layout hue without a recorded user or designated-reference basis; small semantic status colors require a content reason and must not become the background or main visual.

typography.description_role: Light 300; use the group color for the actual light/dark backing
